name: App Marketing PDV Pix Gateway for WooCommerce
author: appmarketing

sections.description:
Pix payment gateway compatible with WooCommerce.

Receive payments via Pix using the PDV Pix API.

The plugin allows your customers to make payments using Pix within your online store, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, via QR code or “copy and paste”.

It is practical, fast, and secure for both the customer and your store. Payment confirmation is performed in real time.

PLUGIN ADVANTAGES

  • Real-time update after payment
  • Higher conversion rates
  • Deposits via Pix to the desired key
  • Integration with PDV Pix
  • More autonomy for charges and payments
  • Real-time Pix QR Code generation
  • Dashboard for monitoring all transactions

START ACCEPTING PIX IN YOUR WOOCOMMERCE AND OFFER THE MOST PRACTICAL PAYMENT OPTION ON THE MARKET

1 – Install the plugin on your WordPress site
2 – Create an account on PDV Pix
3 – Copy your API information from your PDV Pix account and insert it in the “Configure integration information” section

Done! After these steps, your online store can accept Pix payments.

External Services

This plugin connects to the PDV Pix/App Marketing API to process PIX payments and register financial transactions on the platform. Service provided by APP MARKETING LTDA.

The plugin sends the following data to the API whenever a customer makes a PIX payment in the store:

  • API key
  • Environment used (production/sandbox)
  • Account email
  • Account password
  • Receiving account token
  • Receiving unit token

This data is required for account authentication and payment processing.

sections.installation:
1 – Upload the plugin to your website
2 – Activate it
3 – Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Pix via PDV Pix and configure the plugin
sections.faq:
WHAT CONFIGURATION IS REQUIRED TO USE THE PLUGIN?

  • Have WordPress 6.0 or higher installed;
  • Have the WooCommerce plugin 3.0 or higher installed;
  • Use PHP version 7.3 or higher;
  • Have an active PDV Pix account

WHERE ARE THE RECEIVED TRANSACTIONS DEPOSITED?

The transactions are deposited directly into the account associated with the token provided in the “Configure integration information” section.

HOW TO CONFIRM A PIX PAYMENT?

The plugin automatically informs WooCommerce of the payment status, but if you need to verify and confirm a specific transaction, simply access your PDV Pix account and go to the Financial > Revenue menu.

Within the platform you will find all generated transactions and will be able to see all details, issue refunds, and much more.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial version of the plugin.

1.0.1

  • Bug fix product sending via api.

1.0.2

  • Bug fixes for product amount and quantity calculation.

1.0.3

  • Multi-currency support: correct charge amount for orders in currencies other than the account currency (e.g. Curcy), using the order’s exchange rate; send the conversion rate to the API.

1.0.4

  • Add Brazilian Portuguese (pt_BR) translation.
  • Fix: show the original amount in the account currency (e.g. CLP 40.000) instead of the store currency symbol on the payment page.

1.0.5

  • Rename the “Pix Key” setting to “Account token” and clarify the field descriptions in the payment gateway settings.
  • Update the readme and the pt_BR translation to match the new terminology.

1.0.6

  • Update the production real-time payment notification endpoint to the new server port.
